title: Charles Wallace India Trust Scholarships
description:
Grants for Indian citizens in the arts, heritage conservation and the humanities to study or research in the UK.

  • Long-term grants towards a one-year UK master’s
  • Short research grants for doctoral and established researchers

Eligibility: Indian citizens; long-term grants are for applicants aged about 28 to 38 with an unconditional offer for a relevant one-year master’s.

How to apply: Applications are administered through the British Council in India. The last cycle closed in early February, so expect the next deadline around February 2027.

title: Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation Scholarships
description:
Highly competitive awards for outstanding young Indians to take postgraduate or doctoral study at top universities in the UK, Europe and the USA.

  • Tuition and living costs, up to about USD 100,000 or more in total
  • Travel to the host country

Eligibility: Indian citizens living in India with an offer from a top overseas university. Several subjects such as engineering, computer science, MBA and medicine are usually excluded — check the current rules.

How to apply: Applications usually open in early in the year and close around the end of March.

title: Fulbright-Nehru Master’s Fellowships
description:
Fellowships for outstanding Indian professionals to complete a master’s degree at a US college or university.

  • Tuition and fees
  • Living and related costs
  • Round-trip economy airfare
  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Indian citizens with a US-equivalent bachelor’s degree (55%+) and at least three years of relevant full-time work experience. Government employees are not eligible.

How to apply: Apply online through USIEF. The 2027-28 round closed in mid-2026; the next round is expected to open around February 2027.

title: Fulbright-Nehru Doctoral Research Fellowships
description:
Six- to nine-month research fellowships in the US for Indian PhD students registered at Indian institutions.

  • Round-trip economy airfare
  • Monthly living and research allowances
  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Indian citizens registered for a PhD at an Indian institution, with a letter from their supervisor.

How to apply: Apply through the IIE portal. Deadlines have been around 1 July in recent cycles.

title: Fulbright Pakistan Master’s and PhD Scholarships
provider: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
description:
Pakistan’s largest US government scholarship programme, funding master’s and PhD study at American universities.

  • Tuition and required textbooks
  • Round-trip airfare
  • Living stipend
  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Pakistani citizens living in Pakistan with a strong academic record (usually 16 years of education).

How to apply: Apply online through USEFP. The previous cycle closed on 1 April, so expect a similar deadline in 2027.

title: Sussex Chancellor’s International Scholarship
description:
Merit scholarships for outstanding international students starting a master’s at the University of Sussex.

  • GBP 5,000 tuition fee reduction

Eligibility: Overseas fee-paying applicants with an offer for an eligible master’s; not based on financial need.

How to apply: Apply online. Recent rounds closed at the end of April.

title: Glasgow World Changers India Excellence Award
description:
A University of Glasgow award for high-achieving students from India starting a postgraduate taught master’s.

  • Tuition fee discount for the first year (value set each year — see the official page)

Eligibility: Indian nationals with an offer for an eligible full-time postgraduate taught programme.

How to apply: Closes 31 March 2027.

title: UCL Global Master’s Scholarship
description:
Up to 85 scholarships for overseas students from lower-income backgrounds starting a full-time master’s at UCL.

  • GBP 15,000 for one year (split over two years on two-year programmes)

Eligibility: Overseas fee-payers from a lower-income background with a complete application for a full-time UCL master’s. Some awards are ring-fenced for students from India.

How to apply: The last deadline was 7 May 2026; the next is expected in early May 2027.

title: Glasgow Global Leadership Scholarship
description:
Tuition discounts for international and EU fee students starting a postgraduate taught master’s in any discipline at Glasgow.

  • Tuition fee discount for one year (GBP 10,000 in the 2026/27 round)

Eligibility: International or EU fee status with an offer for a full-time taught master’s for 2027/28.

How to apply: Awarded on a rolling basis with no fixed closing date — apply early.

title: Bristol Think Big Scholarships
description:
Bristol’s flagship scholarships for international undergraduate and master’s students.

  • Postgraduate awards of GBP 6,500, GBP 13,000 or GBP 26,000 for the first year
  • Undergraduate awards also available

Eligibility: Overseas fee status and an application for an eligible course; an offer is not required to apply.

How to apply: Applications open 27 October 2026 and close at 1pm UK time on 19 March 2027.

title: Nottingham Developing Solutions Masters Scholarship
description:
For students from Africa, India and selected Commonwealth countries who want to help develop their home countries.

  • 50% or 100% of tuition fees for one year

Eligibility: Domiciled in Africa, India or a listed Commonwealth country, with an offer for a full-time master’s in an eligible faculty.

How to apply: The 2026 round closed in spring; expect a similar deadline in 2027.

title: Cardiff Vice-Chancellor’s Postgraduate International Scholarship
description:
Automatic tuition discounts for international students on selected postgraduate taught programmes at Cardiff.

  • GBP 4,000 to GBP 10,000 tuition discount (GBP 6,000 for countries such as Pakistan, Kenya and Egypt)

Eligibility: International applicants from eligible countries who accept their offer and pay any deposit by the date on the offer letter.

How to apply: No separate application; the date that matters is the acceptance/deposit deadline in your offer.

title: Exeter Excellence Scholarship
description:
Exeter’s main international scholarship (formerly Global Excellence), with 300 awards a year.

  • GBP 15,000 tuition fee reduction
  • 150 undergraduate and 150 postgraduate taught awards

Eligibility: International fee-paying applicants with an offer for September 2027 entry.

How to apply: Applications for September 2027 entry are open; check the official page for the closing date.

title: Manchester Global Futures Scholarship
description:
Large undergraduate scholarships for high-achieving international students, with regional rounds for Africa and South Asia.

  • GBP 12,000 per year for up to three years (GBP 36,000)
  • Paid as a tuition fee discount

Eligibility: International undergraduate applicants for September 2027. Medicine, dentistry, architecture and foundation years are excluded.

How to apply: Deadlines vary by region: Africa 25 February and 8 April 2027; India requires Manchester as UCAS firm choice by 15 May 2027.

title: Leeds Masters International Excellence Scholarships
description:
Tuition discounts for self-funded international students starting a taught master’s at Leeds.

  • GBP 3,000, GBP 6,000 or GBP 16,000 tuition fee discount

Eligibility: International fee status, an offer for a full-time taught master’s starting September 2027, and a 2:1 or equivalent.

How to apply: Round one closes 28 February 2027; round two closes 16 May 2027.

title: Sheffield International Postgraduate Scholarship
description:
An automatic award for offer holders from selected countries, including India and Nigeria, starting a master’s at Sheffield.

  • GBP 7,000 tuition fee discount

Eligibility: Full-time international offer holders from the listed countries.

How to apply: Accept your offer before 4pm UK time on 6 July 2027.

title: QMUL Global Excellence Scholarship
description:
Rolling scholarships for international postgraduate taught students with a first-class degree.

  • GBP 8,000 tuition fee reduction

Eligibility: Overseas fee status, a first-class degree or equivalent, and an offer for an eligible full-time master’s.

How to apply: Allocated on a rolling basis until April 2027.

title: York Global Impact Masters Scholarship
description:
Automatic awards for international master’s students, with the top rate reserved for South Asian and African applicants.

  • GBP 5,000 to GBP 8,000 for the first year
  • GBP 8,000 for Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana and Egypt

Eligibility: Overseas fee-paying full-time applicants holding an offer.

How to apply: No separate application. The 2026 round ended on 1 September; 2027 entry details are expected shortly.

title: York International Masters Achievement Scholarship
description:
Competitive awards for high-achieving international students starting a taught master’s at York.

  • Up to GBP 10,000 tuition fee reduction

Eligibility: Overseas fee-paying students with an offer for a full-time taught master’s.

How to apply: Check the official page for the 2027 deadline (the 2026 round closed on 1 September).

title: Strathclyde Faculty of Science International Undergraduate Scholarships
description:
Up to 25 renewable scholarships for international students starting a science degree at Strathclyde.

  • GBP 6,000 to GBP 7,000 per year, renewable for the length of the degree

Eligibility: International applicants to an undergraduate programme in the Faculty of Science.

How to apply: Recent deadline: 31 July.

title: Strathclyde Humanities & Social Sciences Dean’s International Excellence Scholarship
description:
Six prestigious awards for international students on taught master’s programmes in humanities and social sciences.

  • GBP 10,000 towards tuition for one year

Eligibility: International fee-paying applicants with an offer for an eligible HaSS master’s.

How to apply: Recent deadline: 31 August.

title: Stephen Young Global Leaders’ Programme
description:
Full scholarships for up to five future leaders a year on Strathclyde’s MBA and MSc programmes.

  • Full tuition
  • Living costs

Eligibility: Applicants with leadership potential admitted to an eligible Strathclyde Business School programme.

How to apply: Recent deadline: 31 May for September entry.

title: Aberdeen Global Scholarship (Postgraduate)
description:
A tuition waiver for all new self-funded international master’s students studying on campus at Aberdeen.

  • GBP 8,000 tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: Self-funded, full-time, on-campus international fee-status master’s students (taught or research).

How to apply: Applied as a fee discount; confirm 2027/28 terms with the university.

title: Leicester Chancellor’s International Postgraduate Scholarship
description:
A tuition discount for international students starting a full-time campus-based master’s at Leicester.

  • GBP 3,000 tuition fee discount

Eligibility: International fee-paying students starting in January, April or September 2027 or January/April 2028.

How to apply: Check the official page for how and when the discount is applied.

title: Leicester Africa Development Scholarship
description:
A tuition scholarship for students from Sub-Saharan Africa starting a postgraduate taught course at Leicester.

  • Tuition fee reduction (value set each year — see the official page)

Eligibility: Permanently domiciled in Sub-Saharan Africa with an offer for a postgraduate taught programme.

How to apply: Applied to tuition only and not transferable.

title: Southampton GREAT Scholarship (Nigeria)
description:
A British Council GREAT award for Nigerian students on a one-year taught master’s at Southampton.

  • GBP 10,000 towards tuition

Eligibility: Nigerian nationals with an offer for an eligible one-year, on-campus taught master’s.

How to apply: Applications close at 5pm UK time on 30 April 2027.

title: SOAS Mo Ibrahim Foundation Scholarship
description:
Fully funded awards for African students on a one-year taught master’s at SOAS.

  • Full tuition fees
  • Maintenance stipend (about GBP 45,000 total value per award)

Eligibility: Preference for applicants ordinarily resident in Africa with an offer for an eligible SOAS master’s.

How to apply: The last round closed on 17 June 2026; expect a similar deadline in 2027.

title: SOAS Hyundai Motor Group Scholarship
description:
A full master’s scholarship at SOAS for African nationals living in Africa.

  • Award of about GBP 27,700 from which full tuition is paid
  • Remainder towards living costs

Eligibility: African nationals ordinarily resident in Africa, international fee payers, with a first-class degree or equivalent.

How to apply: Check the official page for the 2027 deadline.

title: SOAS Sustainable Development Goal Scholarship
description:
Full scholarships for taught master’s courses at SOAS linked to the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

  • Full tuition fees
  • Maintenance stipend of at least GBP 15,000

Eligibility: Applicants with an offer for an eligible SDG-related master’s.

How to apply: Check the official page for the 2027 deadline.

title: SOAS International Master’s Scholarships
description:
More than 150 tuition waivers a year for overseas students starting a master’s at SOAS.

  • GBP 8,000 tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: Overseas fee-paying applicants with an offer for a SOAS master’s.

How to apply: The last round closed on 30 June 2026.

title: Allan and Nesta Ferguson Scholarship at Birmingham
provider: University of Birmingham / Allan and Nesta Ferguson Trust
description:
Two fully funded places a year for African students on Birmingham’s one-year MSc in International Development.

  • Full tuition
  • Stipend
  • Flights and visa costs

Eligibility: African nationals with an offer for the MSc International Development who could not otherwise afford to study.

How to apply: Applications open in early 2027.

title: St Andrews International Undergraduate Scholarship
description:
Need-based tuition reductions for overseas students starting an undergraduate degree at St Andrews.

  • Tuition fee reduction for each year of study (value confirmed each December)

Eligibility: Overseas fee-status applicants with demonstrated financial need.

How to apply: Applications close 27 January 2027.

title: St Leonard’s Masters Scholarship (International)
description:
Scholarships for international students on one-year taught master’s programmes at St Andrews.

  • Tuition support for one year (value confirmed each cycle)

Eligibility: International applicants to an eligible MLitt, MSc, MRes or MPP programme.

How to apply: Applications close 3 February 2027.

title: St Andrews Postgraduate Research Scholarships
description:
Funded PhD scholarships across disciplines at the University of St Andrews.

  • Tuition fees
  • Annual stipend (2027-28 rate confirmed by December 2026)

Eligibility: Applicants for a doctoral programme at St Andrews, including international students.

How to apply: Applications close 20 January 2027.

title: University of Sydney International Research Scholarship (USYDIS)
description:
Sydney’s full package for international research students, combining a living stipend with a 100% tuition scholarship.

  • Stipend of AUD 44,293 a year (2027 rate)
  • 100% tuition fees for up to 14 research periods
  • Relocation and thesis allowances

Eligibility: International applicants for a PhD or research master’s at the University of Sydney.

How to apply: Next deadline 18 December 2026 (for research periods 3-4, 2027); then 10 September 2027.

title: UQ Graduate Research School Scholarship
description:
The University of Queensland’s main scholarship for PhD and MPhil students, including international applicants.

  • Living stipend of AUD 39,220 a year tax-free (2026 rate)
  • Tuition scholarship for international students
  • Overseas Student Health Cover

Eligibility: Applicants for a UQ PhD or MPhil with a strong research record.

How to apply: UQ runs several rounds a year; dates for 2027 are published on the scholarships site.

title: Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship (50%)
description:
A prestigious, limited scholarship halving tuition for international students with excellent results.

  • 50% tuition reduction for the full program

Eligibility: International applicants with an ATAR of 99 (undergraduate) or a GPA of 6.7/7 or equivalent.

How to apply: Check the official page for intake deadlines.

title: UWA Global Excellence Scholarship
description:
Automatic tuition discounts for international students with strong results.

  • 10% or 20% off tuition for the whole course (2027 entry)

Eligibility: International applicants with an offer and an ATAR of 85+ (undergraduate) or WAM of 65+ (postgraduate) or equivalent.

How to apply: No separate application.

title: Deakin Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholarship
description:
Deakin’s top international award, covering half or all tuition for the whole degree.

  • 50% or 100% tuition for the normal duration of the program
  • Vice-Chancellor’s Professional Excellence Program

Eligibility: New international coursework students with at least an 85% average; Doctor of Medicine excluded.

How to apply: Requires a separate application and panel selection.

title: Macquarie Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholarship
description:
Merit scholarships for high-achieving international students at Macquarie University.

  • Up to AUD 10,000 towards tuition

Eligibility: International applicants with outstanding academic results.

How to apply: Check the official page for round dates.

title: Macquarie African Women in STEM Scholarship
description:
Supports African women to study science, technology, engineering and maths at Macquarie.

  • 50% of total tuition fees

Eligibility: Women from African countries applying to eligible STEM programs.

How to apply: Check the official page for round dates.

title: Curtin Global Merit Scholarship
description:
An automatic tuition discount for international students with strong results at Curtin.

  • 20% off tuition for up to 4 years (bachelor’s) or 2 years (master’s by coursework)

Eligibility: International students meeting the academic threshold (Distinction for 2027-28 intakes).

How to apply: Check the official page for intakes.

title: John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship
description:
Curtin’s higher-value international scholarship for outstanding students.

  • 40% tuition fee discount

Eligibility: High-achieving international applicants.

How to apply: Check the official page for intakes.

title: Griffith Vice Chancellor’s International Scholarship
description:
Griffith’s flagship international scholarship (also referred to as the Remarkable Scholarship).

  • 50% of tuition fees for the whole degree

Eligibility: International full-time students; a GPA of 5.5/7 must be maintained.

How to apply: Trimester 1, 2027 applications close 28 November 2026.

title: Griffith International Academic Merit Scholarship
description:
A merit-based tuition discount for international students at Griffith.

  • 20% of tuition fees

Eligibility: International students with strong academic results.

How to apply: If you qualify for a higher-value Griffith scholarship, that one applies.

title: La Trobe International Scholarships
description:
Tiered tuition scholarships for international students at La Trobe.

  • 30% reduction for a WAM of 75+
  • 50% or 100% by application for a WAM of 80+

Eligibility: International students with strong prior results.

How to apply: Check the official page for intakes.

title: RMIT Future Leaders Scholarship
description:
A tuition scholarship at RMIT for students from India and the subcontinent.

  • 20% tuition reduction for the duration of the program

Eligibility: Students from India and the subcontinent with an offer for an eligible program.

How to apply: Check the official page for 2027 intakes.

title: UTS International Research Training Program Scholarship
description:
The main fully funded route for international PhD and research master’s students at UTS.

  • Tuition for up to 3.5 years (PhD)
  • Living allowance (UTS base rate AUD 40,500 from 2027)
  • Overseas Student Health Cover

Eligibility: International applicants for a UTS research degree.

How to apply: Next international round (2028 Research Session 1) expected to close around 2 June 2027.

title: Western Sydney University International Undergraduate Scholarship
description:
Tuition scholarships for new international undergraduates at Western Sydney University.

  • AUD 10,000 or AUD 5,000 per year, or 50% for an ATAR of 90+

Eligibility: New international undergraduates in 2027; medicine and nursing excluded.

How to apply: No separate application for the merit awards.

title: Western Sydney University International Postgraduate Scholarship
description:
Tuition contributions for new international postgraduate coursework students.

  • AUD 10,000 or AUD 5,000 per year

Eligibility: New international postgraduate students starting in 2027.

How to apply: Subject to ongoing eligibility.

title: UOW University Excellence Scholarship
description:
An automatic 30% tuition scholarship for high-achieving international undergraduates.

  • 30% tuition reduction for the minimum course duration

Eligibility: International undergraduates with strong results; some degrees excluded.

How to apply: Issued automatically with offers for 2027.

title: UOW Postgraduate Academic Excellence Scholarship
description:
An automatic 30% tuition scholarship for international master’s by coursework students.

  • 30% tuition reduction for the minimum course duration

Eligibility: A completed bachelor’s or master’s with an overall result of 85% or equivalent.

How to apply: No application needed.

title: Monash International Merit Scholarship
description:
Twenty scholarships a year for outstanding international students at Monash.

  • AUD 15,000 a year for the duration of the degree (up to AUD 75,000)

Eligibility: International students with an excellent academic record.

How to apply: Check the official page for round dates.

title: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship
description:
Fee sponsorship for students from lower-income countries starting an undergraduate degree at Melbourne.

  • 20% fee sponsorship (from 2027)
  • 225 scholarships

Eligibility: Citizens of countries with GDP per capita of USD 10,000 or less, including most of South Asia and Africa.

How to apply: Cannot be combined with another fee discount.

title: UNSW International Scientia Coursework Scholarship
description:
UNSW’s flagship international coursework award, recognising merit and leadership.

  • Full tuition, or AUD 20,000 per year towards tuition

Eligibility: International students starting full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework (UNSW online and Canberra excluded).

How to apply: Term 1 2027 applications closed on 30 October 2026; later 2027 terms have their own rounds.

title: UC International First Year Scholarship
description:
A tuition award for international students starting their first year at the University of Canterbury.

  • NZD 15,000 towards tuition fees

Eligibility: International students who studied overseas and have applied for admission.

How to apply: Two rounds a year: 15 April (Semester 2 start) and 31 October (Semester 1 start).

title: Waikato Vice-Chancellor’s International Excellence Scholarship
description:
Merit scholarships for international students enrolling at Waikato for the first time (with a dedicated India version).

  • Up to NZD 15,000 towards tuition

Eligibility: First-time international undergraduate or postgraduate students with strong results.

How to apply: Check the official page for closing dates.

title: University of Alberta International Admission Scholarship
description:
Automatic entrance scholarships for international undergraduates based on admission average.

  • Up to CAD 10,000
  • Larger awards also available, e.g. the President’s International Distinction Scholarship (CAD 120,000 over 4 years)

Eligibility: International students admitted to a first undergraduate degree.

How to apply: No separate application for the admission scholarship.

title: York University Global Leader of Tomorrow Award
description:
Two prestigious renewable awards a year for international students who are leaders in their communities.

  • CAD 20,000 per year for four years (CAD 80,000)

Eligibility: International secondary school applicants with A-range results and leadership through service, arts or sport.

How to apply: Apply through MyFile between 1 December 2026 and 1 April 2027.

title: University of Calgary International Entrance Scholarship
description:
Two renewable entrance awards a year for international undergraduates at Calgary.

  • CAD 20,000, renewable in years 2-4 with a GPA of 2.60

Eligibility: International students entering first year of any undergraduate degree in the fall.

How to apply: Check the registrar’s awards page for the application window.

title: McGill Major Entrance Scholarships
description:
Renewable entrance scholarships for first-year undergraduates at McGill, including international students.

  • CAD 3,000 to CAD 12,000 per year, renewable up to 4 years (the top tier is for Canadians)

Eligibility: First-year applicants; a separate scholarship application is required.

How to apply: Applicants from outside Canada must apply by 21 January 2027.

title: Concordia International Tuition Award of Excellence
description:
Reduces tuition for incoming international doctoral students at Concordia to the Quebec resident rate.

  • About CAD 47,000 in tuition savings

Eligibility: Incoming US or international students admitted to a Concordia doctoral programme.

How to apply: Considered with your doctoral admission.

title: Western University International President’s Entrance Scholarships
description:
Western’s most prestigious entrance awards reserved for international students.

  • Up to CAD 100,000 over four years (amounts vary by award)

Eligibility: International visa students entering first year who are nominated or apply through the National Scholarship Program.

How to apply: Check the Registrar’s page for current amounts and deadlines.

title: McMaster University Award of Excellence (International)
description:
Major entrance awards for international undergraduate students at McMaster.

  • Up to CAD 200,000 over four years (set by each faculty)

Eligibility: International fee-paying students applying to first-year undergraduate programs.

How to apply: Apply through AwardSpring between 1 November 2026 and 19 February 2027.

title: University of Manitoba International Excellence Entrance Scholarship
description:
Three awards a year for exceptional international high school graduates with leadership potential.

  • One award of CAD 25,000 and two of CAD 10,000

Eligibility: International high school graduates entering the University of Manitoba.

How to apply: Applications close 1 December 2026.

title: SFU International Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarship
description:
SFU’s top entrance award for international students, covering tuition for a first degree.

  • Up to CAD 140,000 (tuition and mandatory fees)

Eligibility: International high school applicants for Fall 2027.

How to apply: Apply between 1 October and 15 December 2026.

title: Princeton University Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Princeton is need-blind for international applicants and meets their full demonstrated need with grants, not loans.

  • Need-based grants covering tuition, housing, food and more
  • No loans required

Eligibility: All admitted undergraduates, regardless of citizenship. No merit scholarships are offered.

How to apply: Regular decision deadline: 1 January 2027.

title: Dartmouth College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Dartmouth has been need-blind for international applicants since the Class of 2026 and meets 100% of demonstrated need.

  • Need-based grants
  • No loans in aid awards

Eligibility: All admitted undergraduates, regardless of citizenship.

How to apply: Regular decision deadline in early January 2027.

title: Radboud Scholarship Programme
description:
Cuts tuition for talented non-EU students on English-taught master’s programmes at Radboud University.

  • Tuition reduced to about EUR 2,771 instead of about EUR 19,000
  • Help with visa, residence permit and insurance costs

Eligibility: Non-EU students fully admitted to an English-taught master’s starting 1 September 2027.

How to apply: Apply in OSIRIS by 31 January 2027; the application must be complete by 14 February 2027.

title: University of Twente Scholarship (UTS)
description:
Scholarships for excellent non-EU/EEA students entering a master’s at the University of Twente.

  • EUR 3,000 to EUR 22,000 for one year
  • Possible additional Kipaji Scholarship

Eligibility: Non-EU/EEA students (provisionally) admitted to an eligible master’s starting September 2027.

How to apply: Applications close at 4pm CET on 1 April 2027.

title: Maastricht University NL-High Potential Scholarship
description:
Eighteen full scholarships a year for top non-EEA students on Maastricht master’s programmes.

  • Full tuition fee waiver
  • Living allowance of EUR 20,150 (EUR 1,550 per month)

Eligibility: Non-EEA students with a GPA of 7.5/10 or higher, aged 35 or under, with no previous Dutch degree.

How to apply: Submit a complete master’s application by 10 December 2026, then the scholarship application by 1 February 2027.

title: Groningen Eric Bleumink Fellowship
description:
A fellowship for master’s students from the world’s least developed countries at the University of Groningen.

  • Tuition fees for the master’s programme
  • Study allowance

Eligibility: Students from low-income countries; least developed countries get priority.

How to apply: You cannot apply directly: complete your master’s application before 1 December 2026 to be considered for nomination.

title: VU Amsterdam Fellowship Programme
description:
A merit-based tuition waiver for outstanding non-EU/EEA master’s students at VU Amsterdam.

  • Full or partial tuition fee waiver
  • Can be combined with the NL Scholarship

Eligibility: Non-EU/EEA passport holders not eligible for the lower tuition fee, with conditional admission.

How to apply: Apply for your programme by 1 December 2026; the scholarship closes 1 February 2027.

title: TU/e Scholarship for Excellence
description:
Scholarships for highly talented international students on selected TU/e master’s programmes.

  • Tuition support (value set each year — see the official page)

Eligibility: Applicants to selected master’s in applied physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or mathematics and computer science, with a non-Dutch prior diploma.

How to apply: Submit a complete application by 1 January 2027 to be considered automatically.

title: Tilburg University Waiver
description:
Halves the institutional tuition fee for master’s students from eligible non-EEA countries.

  • 50% reduction of the institutional tuition fee
  • 21 waivers a year

Eligibility: Non-EEA applicants from eligible countries; a lottery is used if there are more eligible applicants than places.

How to apply: Apply before 1 April 2027.

title: Université Grenoble Alpes IdEx Master Scholarships
description:
Scholarships for international students admitted to a master’s or engineering degree at Université Grenoble Alpes.

  • EUR 9,000 for M1 / 2nd-year engineering
  • EUR 5,500 for M2 / 3rd-year engineering

Eligibility: International students selected by their faculty on academic merit; not all degrees take part.

How to apply: Each degree sets its own calendar; the call runs from December to July. Tuition is not waived.

title: Padua International Excellence Scholarship
description:
Excellence scholarships for international students on degree programmes at one of Europe’s oldest universities.

  • EUR 8,000 gross per year
  • Full exemption from student fees
  • Up to 2 years (master’s) or 3 years (bachelor’s)

Eligibility: International students applying to a bachelor’s, master’s or single-cycle degree at Padua.

How to apply: The 2027/28 call is published in November 2026; awards mostly go to first-call applicants.

title: Politecnico di Milano Merit-Based International Scholarships
description:
Platinum, Gold and Silver awards for international students on English-taught MSc programmes.

  • Platinum: EUR 10,000 gross plus full tuition waiver
  • Gold and Silver awards with tuition waiver
  • Renewable for a second year

Eligibility: International students who apply in the Early Bird period and submit an English certificate by 4 March 2027.

How to apply: No separate application: pay the admission fee between 1 October and 1 December 2026.

title: Lazio DiSCo Regional Scholarship
description:
Income-based regional grants for students at universities in Lazio, including Rome, open to international students.

  • About EUR 6,571 per year for students living away from home
  • Free meals worth about EUR 600
  • Higher amounts for lower incomes

Eligibility: Students enrolled at a university in Lazio who meet the income (ISEE) limits; international students submit translated income documents.

How to apply: The call is published in early summer each year; expect a deadline around August-September 2027.

title: ER.GO Emilia-Romagna Regional Scholarship
description:
Income-based grants for students at universities in Emilia-Romagna (Bologna, Modena, Parma, Ferrara), including international students.

  • About EUR 8,250 per year for students living away from home
  • Accommodation options in ER.GO residences

Eligibility: Students meeting the income limits (ISEE up to EUR 25,000).

How to apply: The call is usually published in July with a deadline in September.

title: Linköping University International Scholarships
description:
Tuition waivers for fee-paying international master’s students at Linköping University.

  • 25%, 50% or 75% tuition fee waiver (most commonly 50%)

Eligibility: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss fee-payers who list a LiU master’s as their first choice in the first admission round.

How to apply: Apply by the first-round deadline in mid-January 2027; pass 75% of first-year courses to keep it.

title: Chalmers IPOET Scholarship
description:
Swedish government-funded scholarships for fee-paying master’s students at Chalmers.

  • 75% tuition fee waiver
  • Valid for two years under conditions

Eligibility: Fee-paying applicants to a Chalmers master’s programme; selection mainly on grades.

How to apply: The scholarship deadline matches the master’s application deadline in mid-January 2027.

title: AIT Royal Thai Government Scholarships
description:
Thai government scholarships for master’s and doctoral study at AIT, open to several South Asian countries.

  • Full tuition and registration fees
  • Monthly stipend
  • Accommodation allowance

Eligibility: Nationals of eligible countries including Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.

How to apply: Check the AIT financial aid page for the current call.

title: HKU Presidential PhD Scholar Programme
description:
HKU’s most generous package for outstanding PhD students from around the world.

  • Up to about HKD 445,800 (USD 57,150) in the first year
  • Up to about HKD 428,300 in later years

Eligibility: All applicants for a full-time HKU PhD are considered.

How to apply: Main round runs 1 September to 1 December 2026; applying for the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship too is recommended.

title: CUHK Admission Scholarships for International Undergraduates
provider: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
description:
Entrance scholarships for outstanding undergraduates, including international students, at CUHK.

  • HKD 5,000 up to full tuition
  • Allowance of up to HKD 66,000 per year for some awards

Eligibility: Students admitted to a full-time CUHK undergraduate programme. Need-based aid is not available to international students.

How to apply: No separate application; considered automatically with admission.

title: NTU Research Scholarship
description:
Funded PhD places at Nanyang Technological University for students from around the world.

  • Full tuition
  • Monthly stipend of about SGD 3,000 for international students (school-dependent)
  • Up to 4 years

Eligibility: Applicants admitted to an NTU research programme.

How to apply: Many schools use a 1 October 2026 to 31 January 2027 window; check your school.

title: Korea University International Undergraduate Scholarships
description:
Merit scholarships awarded with admission, including the KU Global Friends award for students from Africa and other developing regions.

  • Up to full tuition for 4 to 8 semesters (Anam Global, KU STEM, Global Friends)
  • Partial awards (Global Leader, Bright Future)

Eligibility: International freshman applicants; renewal depends on GPA and credits.

How to apply: Decided from the admission evaluation; no separate application.

title: SNU Global Scholarship
description:
About 160 awards a year for international graduate students at Korea’s top university.

  • Support for tuition, living expenses, airfare and housing (varies by recipient)

Eligibility: International students admitted to SNU graduate programmes.

How to apply: Check the SNU Office of International Affairs for application dates.

title: Khalifa University Graduate Scholarship for International Students
description:
Tiered graduate scholarships at one of the Gulf’s leading science and engineering universities.

  • Master’s: full or partial tuition plus visa and travel support
  • PhD: full tuition and a monthly stipend (Tier I about AED 20,000 plus allowance)

Eligibility: International applicants admitted to a Khalifa University graduate programme; assessed during admission.

How to apply: Benefits are subject to change; confirm with the university.

title: Hamad Bin Khalifa University Graduate Scholarships
description:
Stipends and tuition waivers for international graduate students at HBKU in Doha.

  • PhD stipend QAR 9,000 per month
  • Master’s stipend QAR 7,000 per month
  • Tuition waivers of 0-100% by programme
  • One round-trip airfare

Eligibility: International students admitted to an HBKU graduate programme; housing is not covered.

How to apply: International graduate admission deadline is around 1 February 2027.

title: Rotary Yoneyama Memorial Scholarship (Overseas Candidates)
description:
Monthly scholarships for overseas students who will enrol at a Japanese university or graduate school.

  • JPY 100,000 per month (undergraduate)
  • JPY 140,000 per month (master’s and doctoral)
  • Airfare subsidy

Eligibility: Overseas students with JLPT N3 or above who have applied for admission to a Japanese university.

How to apply: The 2027 window closed on 31 October 2026; the next opens 1 October 2027.

title: Mastercard Foundation AfOx Graduate Scholarships (Oxford MBA)
description:
Up to three full scholarships for African students on the Oxford MBA at Saïd Business School.

  • Full course fees
  • Living grant of at least GBP 21,805
  • Leadership training and networking

Eligibility: African citizens ordinarily resident in Africa who do not already hold a master’s degree.

How to apply: Considered automatically when you apply for the MBA by 6 January 2027.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at the American University of Beirut
description:
Full scholarships for on-campus master’s programmes at AUB for young Africans and refugees.

  • Full scholarship for a thesis or non-thesis master’s

Eligibility: Citizens of African countries, Lebanese citizens, and refugees in Lebanon or Africa, aged 35 or under.

How to apply: The 2026 deadline was 26 March; an online master’s track for Africans closed in May.

title: Australia Awards Scholarships — South Asia and Mongolia
description:
Australia’s development scholarships for professionals from South Asia and Mongolia.

  • Full tuition
  • Return airfare
  • Living allowance
  • Health cover

Eligibility: Nationals of Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Mongolia.

How to apply: Applications open 1 February and close 30 April each year (2028 intake: February-April 2027).

title: Australia Awards Scholarships — Africa
description:
Master’s scholarships in Australia for mid-career professionals from 24 African countries.

  • Full tuition
  • Return airfare
  • Living allowance
  • Health cover

Eligibility: Citizens of eligible countries (e.g. Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Ethiopia, Egypt, Rwanda), aged 25+, with five years’ work experience and currently employed.

How to apply: The 2028 intake opens 1 February 2027; recent rounds closed 30 April.

title: Ashesi University Scholarships
description:
Need-based aid at one of Africa’s leading liberal arts universities, including Mastercard Foundation Scholars.

  • Partial awards of 30-100% of tuition and housing
  • Comprehensive awards covering full cost, laptop, insurance and travel

Eligibility: African students with financial need; Ashesi recruits from 25+ countries.

How to apply: Submit the financial aid form with your admission application; aid cannot be requested after admission.

title: Pan African University Scholarships
description:
African Union scholarships for master’s and PhD study at Pan African University institutes in Kenya, Nigeria, Cameroon and Algeria.

  • Tuition
  • Monthly stipend
  • Travel and insurance
  • Research support

Eligibility: African nationals; master’s applicants up to 25 (men) or 28 (women), PhD up to 28 or 30.

How to apply: The call normally runs from mid-November to mid-December.
